rules.statement: A package that emits traces uses a single static ActivitySource whose name equals the package name, exposed as a public constant beside its meter name constant.
rules.why: A single source named like the meter lets a host add the whole family with one wildcard AddSource, and ActivitySource has no factory to scope it to a service provider.
rules.check: Look for multiple ActivitySource instances in one package, source names that differ from the package/meter name, hard-coded name strings without a public constant, or attempts to create the source per service provider.

rules.statement: Do not create spans for work that ASP.NET Core or System.Net.Http already traces (inbound requests, outbound HTTP calls); a library span should wrap only its own mechanisms such as waits and store operations.
rules.why: The framework already traces the request and the outbound call, so duplicate spans add noise; the package's value is in exposing the waits and operations around them.
rules.check: Flag new StartActivity calls that wrap an endpoint handler or just an HttpClient call with nothing else inside.

rules.statement: Each span mirrors one of the package's duration histograms: it's named after the histogram without the `.duration` suffix, carries the same bounded attributes, and on failure sets status Error and `error.type` the same way the histogram does.
rules.why: One vocabulary then describes both signals, and both can be cataloged together.
rules.check: Check that a new span has a matching duration histogram, that its name equals the histogram name minus `.duration`, that its tags match the histogram's tags, and that failures set ActivityStatusCode.Error plus an error.type tag.

rules.statement: Never put secrets or personal data on a span: no tokens, handles, cookies, keys, subjects, client ids or request paths; rely on the parent span for correlation.
rules.why: Traces could hold high-cardinality values, but these values are sensitive, and the parent request span already gives correlation.
rules.check: Look at SetTag/AddTag/AddEvent calls on activities for token, cookie, key, handle, subject, client_id, path or similar values.

rules.statement: Library telemetry registration helpers must not turn on tracing for the host; the host adds the package's activity sources to its own tracing pipeline.
rules.why: Tracing is opt-in by the host, and the metrics registration method configures metrics only.
rules.check: Flag metrics registration extension methods that also call AddSource or set up a tracer provider.

rules.statement: When a change adds a span, add or name the histogram it mirrors and document both in the package's telemetry/metrics catalog.
rules.why: The catalog describes both signals using one vocabulary.
rules.check: A diff that adds a new span name and doesn't update the metrics documentation is a violation.

rules.statement: Tests that assert on spans from a shared static ActivitySource must use an ActivityListener that only collects activities under a parent activity the test started itself.
rules.why: Every test in the process shares the source, so a listener without that filter picks up spans from tests running at the same time.
rules.check: Look for test ActivityListeners that collect every activity from the source without filtering by the test's own parent activity or trace id.
